statements.status_notes: PCRE2 before 10.48 allows a pcre2_dfa_match out-of-bounds write because reuse of a cached workspace block, in a recursive DFA matching workspace, lacks a size check (even though a newly allocated block, for the same purpose, does have a size check). This outcome requires an attacker-controlled regular expression, or a recursive pattern in conjunction with a small heap limit (this can be set through the API).
statements.impact_statement: PCRE2 pcre2_dfa_match out-of-bounds write via cached workspace reuse, fixed upstream in PCRE2 10.48 but not yet backported to Ubuntu noble. Liquibase is a pure-Java application (java.util.regex) with no linkage to native libpcre2, and docker-entrypoint.sh performs no regex or grep operations.

statements.status_notes: PCRE2 before 10.48 has a pcre2_match out-of-bounds read after a JIT fallback when an attacker can provide invalid UTF data.
statements.impact_statement: PCRE2 pcre2_match out-of-bounds read after a JIT fallback on invalid UTF data, fixed upstream in PCRE2 10.48 but not yet backported to Ubuntu noble. Liquibase is a pure-Java application (java.util.regex) with no linkage to native libpcre2, and docker-entrypoint.sh performs no regex or grep operations.

statements.status_notes: PCRE2 before 10.48, on 32-bit platforms, has a pcre2_pattern_convert out-of-bounds write when an attacker can provide a large pattern.
statements.impact_statement: PCRE2 pcre2_pattern_convert out-of-bounds write on 32-bit platforms only, fixed upstream in PCRE2 10.48 but not yet backported to Ubuntu noble; not applicable to this image's amd64/arm64 builds regardless. Liquibase is a pure-Java application (java.util.regex) with no linkage to native libpcre2, and docker-entrypoint.sh performs no regex or grep operations.

statements.status_notes: PCRE2 before 10.48, on 32-bit platforms, has a pcre2_compile_32 integer overflow and resultant out-of-bounds write.
statements.impact_statement: PCRE2 pcre2_compile_32 integer overflow and out-of-bounds write on 32-bit platforms only, fixed upstream in PCRE2 10.48 but not yet backported to Ubuntu noble; not applicable to this image's amd64/arm64 builds regardless. Liquibase is a pure-Java application (java.util.regex) with no linkage to native libpcre2, and docker- entrypoint.sh performs no regex or grep operations.

statements.status_notes: PCRE2 before 10.48 has a pcre2_match out-of-bounds read during the PCRE2_MATCH_INVALID_UTF matching of an invalid UTF subject.
statements.impact_statement: PCRE2 pcre2_match out-of-bounds read during PCRE2_MATCH_INVALID_UTF matching, fixed upstream in PCRE2 10.48 but not yet backported to Ubuntu noble. Liquibase is a pure-Java application (java.util.regex) with no linkage to native libpcre2, and docker-entrypoint.sh performs no regex or grep operations.

statements.status_notes: In PCRE2 before 10.48, pcre2_jit_match mishandles a previously copied subject being passed in as a context. An incorrect free operation can occur.
statements.impact_statement: PCRE2 pcre2_jit_match incorrect free on a mishandled copied subject, fixed upstream in PCRE2 10.48 but not yet backported to Ubuntu noble. Liquibase is a pure-Java application (java.util.regex) with no linkage to native libpcre2, and docker-entrypoint.sh performs no regex or grep operations.

statements.status_notes: In PCRE2 before 10.48, pcre2_serialize_encode might disclose two bytes to an adversary, typically in a situation where the access available to the adversary is already unsafe.
statements.impact_statement: PCRE2 pcre2_serialize_encode two-byte information disclosure, fixed upstream in PCRE2 10.48 but not yet backported to Ubuntu noble. Liquibase is a pure-Java application (java.util.regex) with no linkage to native libpcre2, and docker-entrypoint.sh performs no regex or grep operations.
